lines.text: The craftsmen made ten linen curtains with cherubim, joined them in two sets, and used fifty gold clasps.
They made eleven goat hair curtains joined with fifty silver clasps, covered with ram skins dyed red and fine leather.
Bezalel built the ark of acacia wood, overlaid it with pure gold, and made a mercy seat with two cherubim.
He hammered the lampstand from pure gold with six branches, cups shaped like olive blossoms, and seven lamps.
Bezalel son of Uri of the tribe of Judah made everything the LORD commanded, and Oholiab of Dan worked with him.
